test_title: PYST 13: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a family, X and Y are siblings. P has two children and he is the son of G, who is the father-in-law of J. J has only one son. Y is not the granddaughter of G.

How is X related to G?
solution:
The family chart is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26bd089b50ccc65418062a914a10405a9c41cac7d59b1a2ba35d018959360e54.png] 

Drawing the family tree as per the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19860058303932e4d8ffe72e708601cd75ad3e603a7ff01bc2e9fc9fefb9eb2a.png] 

We can see that **X is the granddaughter of G**.

Hence, **Option (2)** is correct.
